rule: Webhook events are dispatched through call_event (saleor.core.utils.events, or the BaseMutation.call_event wrapper) and never by calling the plugin-manager event method directly, so the event fires on_commit.
naive: Adds an extra_category_actions function calling manager.category_updated(instance) directly, copying the neighbouring extra_*_actions in meta/extra_methods.py.
variant_note: In saleor/graphql/meta/extra_methods.py the seed wraps every direct plugin-manager event call in call_event(manager.<event>, instance) in the 12 marked extra_*_actions functions (channel, collection, fulfillment, gift_card, product, variant, shipping_zone, transaction_item, user, warehouse, voucher, shop), so these events fire on commit.
